items.question: I forgot my password, how can I reset it?
items.search_query: I forgot my password, how can I reset it?
items.answer: To reset your password, go to the Password Portal at [https://passwords.novatech.example](https://passwords.novatech.example) and click on the 'Forgot Password?' link. Enter your registered email address and submit the request. Then, check your email for a password reset link, including your spam/junk folder. Click the link in the email to set a new password and follow the prompts to create it, ensuring it meets the password rules outlined below.[1]

items.question: I got a new phone, how do I move Okta Verify to it?
items.search_query: I got a new phone, how do I move Okta Verify to it?
items.answer: To move Okta Verify to your new phone, follow these steps: 1. Install Okta Verify on your new device. 2. Log in to Okta on your computer and go to your account settings. 3. Remove the old device from your MFA settings. 4. Follow the enrollment steps to add your new device.[1]

items.question: How do I connect to the VPN from my Mac at home?
items.search_query: How do I connect to the VPN from my Mac at home?
items.answer: To connect to the VPN from your Mac at home, follow these steps: 1. Open the Cisco Secure Client application on your device. 2. Enter the VPN gateway address: `vpn.novatech.example`. 3. Click on 'Connect.' 4. Enter your Okta credentials (username and password). 5. Complete the Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) using Okta Verify (push notification or 6-digit code). 6. Once authenticated, you will be connected to the VPN and can access internal systems. [1]

items.question: The VPN keeps disconnecting every few minutes, any fix?
items.search_query: The VPN keeps disconnecting every few minutes, any fix?
items.answer: To fix the VPN disconnections, check your internet stability, ensure your VPN settings are correct, and update your VPN client to the latest version [1]. Additionally, consider switching to a wired connection if you are currently using Wi-Fi [1].

items.question: How do I request a licence for software that isn't in Software Center?
items.search_query: How do I request a licence for software that isn't in Software Center?
items.answer: To request a license for software that isn't in the Software Center, you need to go through ServiceHub. Here’s how: 1. Log in to ServiceHub with your Okta credentials. 2. If needed, specify whether you require a paid license. 5. Submit your request for review by the IT team. You will receive a notification regarding the approval status once reviewed. [1]

items.question: How do I get my laptop onto the office Wi-Fi?
items.search_query: How do I get my laptop onto the office Wi-Fi?
items.answer: To connect your laptop to the office Wi-Fi (NovaTech-Corp), follow these steps: 1. Click on the Wi-Fi icon in the system tray (Windows) or menu bar (Mac) and select **NovaTech-Corp** from the list of available networks. 2. Enter your Okta username and password when prompted. If you have Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enabled, complete the MFA process. 3. Accept any security certificates if prompted. 4. items.question: How do I set up work email on my Android phone?
items.search_query: How do I set up work email on my Android phone?
items.answer: To set up your work email on your Android phone, follow these steps: 1. Download the Outlook App from the Google Play Store. 2. Open the Outlook App after installation. 3. Tap on "Get Started" or "Add Account" and enter your company email address (yourname@novatech.example). 4. Sign in with your Okta credentials and complete any multi-factor authentication if prompted. 5. Follow the prompts to configure settings and finish the setup to access your inbox and start sending and receiving emails.[1]

items.question: Outlook isn't syncing my calendar. What should I try?
items.search_query: Outlook isn't syncing my calendar. What should I try?
items.answer: To resolve your calendar syncing issue, try the following steps: 1. **Check Internet Connection**: Ensure you have a stable internet connection. 2. **Verify Account Settings**: Open Outlook, go to **File** > **Account Settings** > **Account Settings**, and ensure your account is set up correctly. 3. **Update Outlook**: Make sure your Outlook is up to date by going to **File** > **Office Account** > **Update Options** > **Update Now**. 4. **Check Sync Settings**: Go to **File** > **Options** > **Calendar** and ensure that the sync settings are correctly configured. 5. **Clear Cache**: Close Outlook, navigate to `C:\Users\<YourUsername>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Outlook`, delete the cache files, and restart Outlook. 6. **Repair Outlook Profile**: If issues persist, you may need to repair your Outlook profile. [1]

items.answer: Yes, you can remote into your office desktop from home, but you must connect through the VPN first [1].

items.search_query: My internet is really slow when working from home.
items.answer: To troubleshoot slow internet at home, follow these steps: 1. Restart your router and device [1]. 2. Check if other devices are also slow [1]. 3. Run a speed test to measure your connection [1]. 4. Close any bandwidth-heavy applications [1].

items.question: An app keeps freezing and crashing on my laptop.
items.search_query: An app keeps freezing and crashing on my laptop.
items.answer: To troubleshoot the application freezing and crashing on your laptop, follow these steps: [1] 1. **Check for Updates**: Ensure that your application is up to date. [1] 2. **Restart the Application**: Close the application completely and reopen it. [1] 3. **Clear Cache**: Clear your browser cache for web applications or check the application settings for desktop applications. [1] 4. **Reinstall the Application**: Uninstall and then reinstall the application, backing up any important data first. [1] 5. **Collect Logs for IT Support**: If the issue persists, gather logs to help IT diagnose the problem. If the application continues to crash after these steps, please contact the IT Service Desk for further assistance [1].

items.question: I think I clicked a link in a phishing email. What do I do?
items.search_query: I think I clicked a link in a phishing email. What do I do?
items.answer: If you think you clicked a link in a phishing email, take the following steps immediately: 1. Disconnect from the Internet to prevent potential malware communication. 2. Run a security scan using your antivirus software to check for malware. 3. Change your passwords for any accounts that may have been compromised. 4. Notify IT by reporting the incident via ServiceHub or email itsupport@novatech.example, providing details about the link you clicked and any unusual activity you noticed. [1]

items.question: How does vesting work?
items.search_query: How does vesting work?
items.answer: Vesting for ESOPs at NovaTech Solutions follows a 4-year schedule with a 1-year cliff. You must remain employed for one full year before any options vest, at which point 25% of your granted options will vest. After the cliff, the remaining 75% will vest quarterly over the next three years, resulting in 6.25% of the options vesting every quarter.[1]
